title: Orbit Loom
summary: A browser editor for writing drawings in Gleam and animating them with live shape and speed controls.
question: How much can one control change the feel of a drawing?

figure.alt: Blue and gold concentric orbits linked by curved pink and purple ribbons on Animator’s canvas.
figure.caption: Twin Comets, an original drawing rendered in my CS 61A Animator project.

sections.title: The drawing editor
sections.text: Orbit Loom grew out of Berkeley’s CS 61A Animator project. I used it to make Twin Comets. In the live editor, you can pick one of the drawings, change its Gleam code next to the canvas, or start a drawing of your own.

sections.title: Twin Comets
sections.text: Two sets of arcs are joined by ribbons. Pick Twin Comets from the drawing menu, then move Shape to see how changing the distance between the centers stretches the ribbons.
